directoryIntros.html: Songs are grouped: demo shows infinite-neck features. practice has songs with drills such as chords, modes, arpeggios and name-that-note.
Songs that demonstrate infinite-neck features, such as how to use plugins (Fill, Arpeggio, Transpose), how to wire Listeners and Observers. Use these as templates for setting up your own songs.
